objective: Make a workstream on the Register screen correctable. server/routes/register.ts exposes PATCH /api/register/workstreams/:workstreamId (~199-233: title, intent, purpose from WORKSTREAM_PURPOSES, records WORKSTREAM_AMENDED), GET .../workstreams/:id (corrections and events), POST .../links/:linkId/supersede (reason) and POST .../archive (reason). client/src/lib/registerApi.ts (~51-93) has workstream(), supersede() and archive() but no amend, and no screen calls workstream(), supersede() or archive() at all (grep client/src). client/src/russell/Register.tsx `WorkstreamCard` (~218-262) is read-only: a person who filed the wrong intent or purpose, or whose link points at the wrong row, has no way to say so from the product (CLAUDE.md §43: 'A correction keeps what it corrects'; 'Archiving keeps the links'). Add `RegisterApi.amend(workstreamId, {title?, intent?, purpose?})` (PATCH). In WorkstreamCard add: an 'Edit what this is' form prefilled with title and intent and a purpose radio offering the same choices FileOne (~291-360) offers; beside each reading in the existing disclosure a 'This link is wrong' control requiring a reason that calls supersede with reading.linkId; an 'Archive' control requiring a reason; and a 'History' disclosure that fetches workstream(id) only when opened and lists events (kind, summary, time) and corrections. After any write, reload the register view (pass Register's query.reload into WorkstreamCard); refusals render the server's sentence verbatim. No state is computed in the client.
expectedOutcome: registerApi gains amend; each workstream card can amend its title/intent/purpose, supersede a wrong link with a reason, archive with a reason, and show its history, all through existing routes.
nonGoals: Any server route, service, schema or migration change (server/routes/register.ts is off limits)
Changing a workstream's project from the screen

acceptanceConditions.statement: tests/registerWorkstreamControls.test.tsx: submitting the edit form sends PATCH /api/register/workstreams/<id> with the edited title, intent and purpose, then re-requests /api/register.
'This link is wrong' with a reason POSTs .../links/<linkId>/supersede with {reason}; 'Archive' with a reason POSTs .../archive with {reason}; both submits are disabled while the reason is empty.
The History disclosure makes no request until opened, then GETs /api/register/workstreams/<id> and lists its events' summaries.
A refused write renders the server's error sentence verbatim; tests/workRegister.test.ts still passes and the repository typechecks.

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commit; client-only change plus one new test; existing links and workstreams are untouched.
